q1_issues.issue: (Goal sk_sentence_1 death) mis-slots "sentenced to death": the PP answers neither whence nor whither, so by the rule to decide obliques by the question the PP answers it takes the preposition-named oblique, not the spatial Goal.

The antecedent conjoins the whole resultative bundle — the reified guilty state, the flat (Member samudra guilty), and the Result link — so all of them must be present before the rule can fire, an over-specified premise for "if found guilty".

The epistemic (Might sk_sentence_1) sits inside the implication's conclusion and so loses the confidence 0.9 the instruction set prescribes for Might/Probably/Must; the whole rule carries one (STV 1.0 0.99).

q2_gaps: "soon after" — a vague temporal-proximity modifier on an ordering; Before carries no degree and BeforeBy requires a stated number plus unit, so "soon" has no carrier and is dropped
an epistemic/status atom inside a rule conclusion has no truth-value slot of its own, so the prescribed epistemic confidence cannot be expressed

"find X guilty" — an evaluative/declarative secondary predicate (a verdict); the resultative-vs-depictive split does not decide whether a verdict counts as a caused result, and the evaluate/record verbs are elsewhere routed to Theme rather than Patient
notes: Indicative conditional as a plain Implication, "after" swapping the Before arguments, the anti_terror_law compound genus with the modifier left unexposed, the reduced-relative "passed" as an agentless past event, and the framing PP (Under ...) are all per spec. The bombings event-noun correctly gets only its class atom and the ordering relation.
